feature: generation-scoped automatic reconnection for future HTTP/2 WebTransport Sessions

targets: cleartext address and host transport ownership
TLS address and host with borrowed verification policy
scope.replay_boundary: an operation on an existing Session is never replayed or migrated; only a later explicit CONNECT can establish a new connection generation
scope.handles: every Session handle contains independent connection and per-connection Session generations

implementation.concurrent_connect: concurrent callers share one in-progress TCP/TLS/HTTP2 connector and then multiplex CONNECT on the same EndpointClient generation
implementation.backoff: retryable connection establishment uses bounded exponential backoff, optional jitter, a minimum connect-attempt timeout and one caller-owned awake deadline
implementation.retirement: terminal transport errors retire the current generation; SessionClosed remains Session-scoped except when a new unaccepted CONNECT proves the old connection cannot host future Sessions
implementation.rejection: HTTP rejection, endpoint capacity and ordinary Session failure do not trigger reconnection
implementation.shutdown: deinit marks the wrapper closed, requests endpoint shutdown and joins active callers before destroying target state
implementation.session_api: DATAGRAM, virtual stream, flow-control, reset/stop, drain/close, remove and exporter operations route only through a matching live connection generation

results.concurrent_sessions: two simultaneous CONNECT calls used one TLS connection generation and received distinct Session handles
results.rejection_reuse: a 429 response with body later remained on generation one; two accepted Sessions followed on the same connection
results.future_reconnect: after generation one terminated, failed Session slots were removed and CONNECT C automatically established generation two within the original deadline
results.stale_handles: generation-one handles returned StaleConnection after generation two became current
results.retry_budget: a custom connector returning ConnectionRefused retried at least twice but fewer than twenty times under a 20-ms deadline and 1-ms backoff
results.allocation: fail-first allocation swept wrapper construction without leaking target state
results.hyper_http2_regression: independent Hyper h2c/TLS client and server matrix passed all 9/9 build steps, including multiplexing, cancellation, GOAWAY, pooling, redirects and TLS KeyUpdate

verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='WebTransport HTTP2 ReconnectingEndpointClient' --summary all
zig build test-lib -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Dtest-filter='WebTransport HTTP2 ReconnectingEndpointClient' --summary all
remaining_gap: The local reference set still has no independent draft-15 WebTransport-over-HTTP2 browser or proxy implementation.
